h3: A score is a point on a cost curve
subs: Mean success against what one session costs at list price, log scale. A model run at several efforts is one line through its points.

tasks.name: reach target single
tasks.instruction: Reach the target with the left wrist.

tasks.name: reach target multi modal
tasks.instruction: Reach the target with either wrist.

tasks.name: reach target dual
tasks.instruction: Reach the two targets, one with each wrist.

tasks.name: move plate
tasks.instruction: Move the plate between two draining racks.

tasks.name: move two plates
tasks.instruction: Move two plates simultaneously from one draining rack to the other.

tasks.name: flip cup
tasks.instruction: Flip the upside-down cup to an upright position.

tasks.name: flip cutlery
tasks.instruction: Take the cutlery from the holder, flip it, and place it back.

tasks.name: stack blocks
tasks.instruction: Move blocks across the table and stack them in the target area.

tasks.name: dishwasher close
tasks.instruction: Push back all trays and close the door of the dishwasher.

tasks.name: dishwasher load cups
tasks.instruction: Move the cups from the table into the dishwasher's upper tray.

tasks.name: dishwasher load cutlery
tasks.instruction: Move the cutlery from the holder on the table into the dishwasher's cutlery basket.

tasks.name: dishwasher load plates
tasks.instruction: Move the plates from the rack into the dishwasher's lower tray.

tasks.name: drawer top open
tasks.instruction: Open the top drawer of the kitchen cabinet.

tasks.name: drawer top close
tasks.instruction: Close the top drawer of the kitchen cabinet.

tasks.name: pick box
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box from the side table and place it on the counter.

tasks.name: put cups
tasks.instruction: Pick up the cups from the table and put them into the closed wall cabinet.

tasks.name: saucepan to hob
tasks.instruction: Take the saucepan from the closed cabinet and place it on the hob.

tasks.name: sandwich remove
tasks.instruction: Remove the sandwich from the frying pan.

tasks.name: wall cupboard open
tasks.instruction: Open the doors of the wall cabinet.

tasks.name: wall cupboard close
tasks.instruction: Close the doors of the wall cabinet.
